meta.description: Machine-readable harness conformance contract. It owns harness layers, support boundaries, evidence requirements, MCP tool classification hints, ContextOS value artifacts, and positioning statements.

validation.unknown_evidence_rule: UNKNOWN evidence never satisfies a validated layer requirement.
validation.overall_status_rule: ATTENTION when evidence fails; PASS_WITH_BOUNDARIES when every required evidence artifact passes but one or more layers are partial or external; PASS only when every layer is native and validated.

layers.purpose: Run SAGE analysis, validation and release workflows deterministically while delegating untrusted agent execution to a bounded host runtime.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE validates its own execution pipeline but does not provide a general untrusted-agent sandbox in V1.

layers.purpose: Expose safe CLI/MCP actions with clear mutation boundaries.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE provides governed repository-intelligence tools; it is not a universal tool runtime or package-security authority.

layers.purpose: Distill repository reality into small, current, agent-usable context.
layers.claim_boundary: ContextOS provides repository-grounded operational context; it is not general long-term agent memory in V1.

layers.purpose: Carry agent work from discovery to validation, handoff and release proof.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE governs repository-analysis, watchdog, handoff and proof lifecycles; it is not a complete autonomous issue-to-PR agent orchestrator.

layers.purpose: Make generated artifacts, provenance and performance observable.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE exposes local proof, freshness, exception and performance telemetry; full model/tool trajectory tracing and production OpenTelemetry export are roadmap capabilities.

layers.purpose: Verify claims with private evals, fixtures, artifact contracts and gates.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE verifies bounded static-governance and self-release claims; full agent-rollout outcome evaluation and target-repository release proof remain separate roadmap scopes.

layers.purpose: Keep humans in authority and prevent unsafe autonomous mutation.
layers.claim_boundary: SAGE provides repository governance, HITL and bounded security checks; it is not a complete agent-security, information-flow-control or SAST platform.

context_value.measurement_boundary: Artifact byte-size projection using a deterministic four-characters-per-token estimate; not an exact tokenizer result, per-request packet size, cost saving, latency result or task-success measurement.

evaluation_boundary.claim_boundary: SAGE preserves model-independent repository evidence, governance and portable memory. Controlled task-outcome evaluation across model and harness variants remains a roadmap capability and must not be inferred from harness readiness.

evaluation_baseline.claim_boundary: This contract defines a future reproducible evaluation manifest. It does not execute a model, collect task outcomes, calculate savings, or prove causal benefit until an opt-in run records all required snapshots, variants and metrics.

positioning.product_category: Deterministic repository-intelligence, verification and governance control plane for coding-agent harnesses.
positioning.not_claimed: SAGE is not a complete agent runtime, general execution sandbox or end-to-end autonomous agent platform in V1.
positioning.meaning: SAGE preserves repository and architectural memory across AI agents, models, and time.
positioning.model_swap_rule: Switch the model, keep the veteran.
positioning.human_capital_rule: Human judgment remains authority; SAGE turns approved architectural knowledge into reusable token capital.
